bio1: I'm Harry Chang. I learn best by building things, even if they break along the way. My work lives at the intersection where AI meets creation, where code becomes story, where curiosity refuses to apologize.
bio2: Admitted to NTU CSIE through Special Admission and currently a senior at Chingshin Academy, I craft with equal passion through research, photography, debate, and video editing, all to make tomorrow more interesting than today.
bio3: From LEGO bricks to language models, I've never outgrown the urge to take things apart and rebuild them better. Got an idea? Let's talk.
